title: Ashmita Chaliha Conquers Korea Masters, Joins Elite Indian Club
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha's victory at the Korea Masters makes her only the fifth Indian woman to win a Super 300 or higher title, a historic moment for Indian badminton.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha's victory at the Korea Masters makes her only the fifth Indian woman to win a Super 300 or higher title, placing her alongside legends like Saina Nehwal and PV Sindhu.

title: India Coach Park Tae-Sang's Hard Work Paying Off
